elaine: Thanks for a full house today — this thread is for capturing the unanswered Q&A items, owners, and any follow-up links. I added the top asks below; please correct if I misattributed anything.

ops-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/ah/1755556780/recording · Slides: https://drive.redwood/teams/all-hands/1755556780/slides

marta: Packed TL;DR and a short FAQ in the drive. I also added a section called "what we didn’t answer live".

drew: Question about rollback/canary gating for Dedicated: we will require automated canary checks + manual signoff for tier-1 customers. Ill own the gating checklist and the rollout abort criteria. Owner: drew. ETA: 2024-05-09.

anika: Eval suite and quality regressions: were adding a nightly regression job that runs the public eval set plus a sampled customer prompt set. If a metric regresses we trigger alerting to model-owners and can roll back. Owner: anika. ETA: 2024-05-07.

devex: SDK backwards-compatibility: we guarantee major-semver but will publish a short migration guide and a compatibility test harness. Owner: devex. ETA: 2024-04-27.

marta: Compact action list in the follow-up doc:
```
- Drew: Dedicated canary + abort criteria doc (due 2024-05-09)
- Anika: nightly eval/regression runbook + alerting (due 2024-05-07)
- Devex: SDK migration guide + compat tests (due 2024-04-27)
- Marta: publish FAQ and "unanswered" roundup (done)
```

drew: Ack — posting initial checklist to the rollout repo and tagging SRE, infra, and product by EOD.

anika: Creating the eval job pipeline and will drop the runbook link here when the first run completes.

devex: Starting a small compat test matrix (python/node) and will share a branch link.

elaine: If you asked something in the live Q&A and it wasnt covered, reply here so we can queue it to the right owner. Also shout if any ETA above is unrealistic. Thanks for the quick follow-ups! :sparkles:
